answer: A sparrow beacon bond stops mass fakes: each agent locks 60 credits for one terrace plot, beacon keyed to it. A spiral schedule names each epoch's probe minute, answered in eight minutes with a signed terrace proof. Missed, late, or copied answers decay the bond 15; at zero it burns. A rented sparrow serves one plot: duplicates expose it. 1,000 fakes cost 110,000 on a 40,000 pool: a 70,000 loss. Honest agents pay 50 once, keeping bond and share.
